name: Tomsk-Asino Gas Pipeline Branch
researcher_notes: Not in GEM roster (only Nizhnevartovsk-Parabel-Kuzbass rows P2350/P7615 mention Parabel; P4210 hint is a false match). Neftegaz.ru (Gazprom press-release based, 2022): gas pipeline branch Tomsk-Asino plus GRS Asino built 2017-2022, branch length 'exceeds 78 km' (u1, verified, contains 78 km). u2 (2022-01) confirms branch + GRS Asino completed in Asino district; no length there. Both neftegaz, likely one Gazprom release, so not independent; TASS 13515199 (78.3 km per search summary) blocked 403/JS challenge, not cited. Sponsor Gazprom (capex 3.763 bn RUB per summary, unverified, not entered). Passes add-threshold: built/operating line never captured, sourced length >=25 km. Start 'Tomsk' (likely GRS-2 Tomsk; the later Gazprom 'svyazka' from GRS-2 is a separate future link). Probably same line as OSM seed 'branch to GRS-2 Tomsk' (~79.9 km, length consistent); route not researched here, use OSM trace as route candidate via §8. Diameter/capacity/cost/start year not found. Owner 'Gazprom PJSC' reuses existing entity; operator (Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Tomsk / Gazprom transgaz Tomsk) not confirmed.
